caption_v7: \caption{\textbf{Beyond an affine change of scale, pretrained vision and language models differ by a residual, not a monotone link, and preprocessing can reverse size trends (Proposition~\ref{prop:cka}, Theorem~\ref{thm:link}).} (a)~Share of the squared-distance discrepancy explained by the nested fits, per pair (thin), median (thick), and under a monotone link (dashed). (b,~c)~CKA and mKNN minus their permutation-null means, relative to the smallest size, as mean $\pm$ s.e.\ over vision models on log axes. Appendix~\ref{app:exp-s12} gives the shares and the exact $p$-values.}
caption_v8: \caption{\textbf{Beyond an affine change of scale, pretrained vision and language models differ by a residual, not a monotone link, and preprocessing can reverse size trends (Proposition~\ref{prop:cka}, Theorem~\ref{thm:link}).} (a)~Share of the squared-distance discrepancy at mid depth explained by the nested fits, per pair (thin), median (thick), and under a monotone link (dashed). (b,~c)~CKA and mKNN minus their permutation-null means, as mean $\pm$ s.e.\ over vision models on log axes. Appendix~\ref{app:exp-s12} gives the shares and the exact $p$-values.}
